behavior: An open trigger of Dialog, Alert Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Menu, Select, Combobox or Autocomplete has no `aria-controls` while no popup or list element that it can name is mounted. An open `NavigationMenu.Trigger` has `aria-controls` with the `id` of its `NavigationMenu.Content`, only while that element is in the document. The server HTML of an open root thus has none. The trigger gives no `aria-controls=""` for an element with an empty `id`. It also names no popup part, `Select.List` or `Combobox.List` while `KeepAlive` holds that part, also when the part mounts in a held branch. `Combobox.Input` has no `aria-controls` while `KeepAlive` holds `Combobox.List`, also when the list mounts in a held branch. `Select.Trigger` follows a change of the `id` of its popup. Base UI differs. Its triggers of Dialog, Alert Dialog, Drawer, Popover and Menu name the default id of the popup while no popup element is mounted, also in the server HTML. Its `Combobox.Trigger` names the default id of the popup while no popup is mounted, and when a `render` prop drops the id of the popup. No element has that id. Its `Select.Trigger`, `Combobox.Trigger` and `NavigationMenu.Trigger` give `aria-controls=""` for an element with an empty `id`.
